annotations.title: Get the proof for a record

description: Fetch the public proof for a recorded action and save it next to the record, with the agent record needed to check it. Free. Returns "pending" if the record is not in a public checkpoint yet (usually a few minutes). Anyone can check a saved proof offline with the verifier at https://augmentev.com/verify. A proof shows that this exact record existed, unchanged, by a certain time. It does not show that what the record describes is true.

index.description: The log index returned by record_action

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the proof if it is not ready yet (default 0, max 45). If still pending, call again later.

name: get_proof
